title: Purpose-separated cooperative B-to-H same-stream HMAC bind (draft)
description: B is the client on its assigned broker socket. The first bridge.bind.cooperative.v3 request has an empty payload and H replies with a fresh single-use 64-lowercase-hex nonce, hmac-sha256 algorithm, fixed context and expiry no later than both A-signed FD3 reservation and detached cooperative B assignment. On the same kernel-authenticated connection B sends the exact proof request. H and B form the HMAC-SHA256 preimage as UTF-8 fields joined by one NUL with no trailing NUL: context, nonce, hq_epoch, installation_id, start_id, launch_id, plan_id, plan_digest, reservation_sha256, bridge_assignment_envelope_sha256, bridge_uid in canonical base-10 with no leading zero, broker_socket_path. Context is ASCII agent-bot-stage2a-cooperative-bridge-bind-v3; key is A's fresh 32 raw FD4 bytes, which never reach R. The bridge_assignment digest is the detached cooperative B assignment already on FD3, never the later two-member B authority digest. H verifies the same A-paired proof and live B UID/PIDVersion/process start before recording bind. Protected v3 bind is separate. A changed/replayed/expired value refuses without policy delivery or traffic.
